title: Display df with double sorting capablities
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

When display df using st function, you can only sort on one col at a time. Need a feature to sort on more columns with priority on what pushed. For example:
Df:
        Team   score  week   goals
P1   a            2           1          1
P2   a            1           2           2
P3    b            1             1          1

If clicked on team - order will be as is. If second click on goals- P2 will switch P1.
